title: Communication Skills
description: For school leavers who want to speak, write and listen with confidence at work, in business and online. You will practise everyday communication skills that employers and clients value in every job.
outcomes: Listen actively and ask good questions
Speak clearly and confidently, including in short presentations
Use body language that builds trust
Write professional emails and WhatsApp messages
Give and receive feedback and work well in a team
Communicate professionally online and at the workplace
